description: A real Intel Mac client answering a live psistorm challenge: Mac Diablo II 1.14.1.68 (platform XMAC, product D2DV, verbyte 0x0E) on Mac OS X 10.13.6, connected to useast.battle.net, 2026-10-09. The raw CD-key part of the SID_AUTH_CHECK packet is not included.

answer.server_reply: 0x51 result 0x100 old game version, patch offered + D2DV_XMAC_1xx_114d.mpq

files_not_hashed: The XMAC library ignores its file arguments (the client passes a path and two empty buffers). It hashes the main bundle's executable only.
notes: Server side (2026-10-09): useast answered 0x100 (old game version) with D2DV_XMAC_1xx_114d.mpq, because 1.14.1.68 is older than the current Mac build. The reply says nothing about whether the hash was valid. psistorm_template.c and psistorm_ref.py reproduce checksum and exe_info over the 1.14.1.68 executable.
